reset.title: Reset your password

password.policy: Use uppercase, lowercase, number, and symbol characters.

error.csrf: Security check failed. Refresh and try again.
error.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again later.
error.otpExpired: The OTP has expired. Request a new one.
error.otpAttemptsExceeded: Too many OTP attempts. Request a new one.
error.resetTokenInvalid: The reset session is invalid or expired.
error.twoFactorMismatch: The two-factor code does not match.
error.twoFactorChallengeInvalid: The two-factor challenge expired. Sign in again.
